description: Read the live OpenID Connect discovery document that the Alza mobile app uses (issuer, authorization endpoint, token endpoint). Use only when debugging the OAuth flow or verifying which identity endpoints Alza exposes before calling `auth_start`. Do not use for everyday shopping — it returns a configuration document, not account data, and changes nothing. Read-only; no credentials are ever sent.
name: auth_discovery

outputSchema.description: Raw OpenID Connect discovery document served by the Alza authority (issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint).

title: Read Alza OAuth discovery
